items.text: Yisukulu ya ŵakutaga mbopesi
Lefi ŵakwete ŵanace ŵatatu, mena gawo galiji Geleshoni, Kohati ni Melali.
Kohati ŵakwete ŵanace mcece, mena gawo galiji Amulamu, Isala, Hebuloni ni Usiyele.
Amulamu ŵakwete ŵanace ŵaŵili ŵacalume, mena gawo galiji Aloni
ni Mose,
soni ŵakwete mwanace jwamkongwe jumo lina lyakwe Miliyamu. Aloni ŵakwete ŵanace mcece, mena gawo galiji Nadabu, Abihu, Eliyesa ni Itamala.
Finihasi ŵaliji mwanace jwa Eliyesa, nipo yisukulu ya Eliyesa yaliji Abishuwa,
Buki, Usi,
Selahiya, Melayoti,
Amaliya, Ahitubi,
Sadoki, Ahimasi,
Asaliya, Yohanani,
Asaliya, jwalakweju ni juŵaliji jwakutumicila ku Nyumba ja AMBUJE
jele jiŵataŵile Mwenye Solomoni ku Yelusalemu.
Amaliya, Ahitubi,
Sadoki, Shalumu,
Hilikiya, Asaliya,
Selaya, Yehosadaki.
Yehosadaki ŵakamwilwe ukapolo pa ndaŵi jele Mlungu ŵamkundile Nebukadinesa kuti ŵakamule ukapolo ŵandu ŵa ku Yuda ni Yelusalemu.
Yisukulu yine ya Alefi
Alefi ŵakwete ŵanace ŵatatu, mena gawo galiji Geleshomu, Kohati ni Melali.
Mena ga ŵanace ŵa Geleshomu galiji Libini ni Shimeyi.
Ŵanace ŵa Kohati ŵaliji Amulamu, Isala, Hebuloni ni Usiyele.
Ŵanace ŵa Melali ŵaliji Mali ni Mushi. Gelega gali mena ga maŵasa ga Alefi gagalembedwe pakukuya acinangolo ŵawo.
Libini ŵaliji mwanace jwa Geleshomu, nipo Yahati, Sima,
Yowa, Ido, Sela, ni Yetelai yili yisukulu ya Geleshomu.
Yisukulu ya Kohati ni ayi: Aminadabu, Kola, Asili,
Elikana, Ebiyasafu, Asili,
Tahati, Uliyele, Usiya ni Shaulo.
Elikana ŵakwete ŵanace ŵaŵili, mena gawo galiji Amasayi ni Ahimoti.
Ayi ni yisukulu ya Ahimoti: Elikana, Sofayi, Nahati,
Eliyabu, Yelohamu ni Elikana.
Samuele ŵakwete ŵanace ŵaŵili. Jwandanda kupagwa ŵaliji Yoweli, nipo jwaŵili ŵaliji Abiya.
Ayi ni yisukulu ya Melali: Mali, Libini, Shimeyi, Usa,
Shimeya, Hagiya ni Asayiya.
Ŵakwimba ku Nyumba ja AMBUJE
Ŵapali ŵandu ŵane ŵele ŵasagulidwe ni Mwenye Daudi
kuti alongoleleje kwimbisya nyimbo m'Nyumba ja kwapopelela AMBUJE mu Yelusalemu, ali aŵisilemo Libokosi lya Cilanga ca AMBUJE.
Ŵakwimba nyimboŵa ŵatumicilaga pa mlango wa citenti cakusimanilana, mpaka pa ndaŵi jiŵataŵile Solomoni Nyumba ja AMBUJE ku Yelusalemu.

Aga ni mena ga ŵandu ŵaŵatumicilagawo pamo ni ŵanace ŵawo: Kutyocela kwiŵasa lya Kohati, ŵapali Hemani juŵaliji jwakulongolela kwimba nyimbo soni ŵaliji mwanace jwa Yoweli. Lukosyo lwawo lwatandilile pa Yakobo,
Hemani, Yoweli, Samuele, Elikana,
Elikana, Yelohamu, Eliele, Towa,
Sufi, Elikana, Mahati, Amasayi,
Elikana, Yoweli, Asaliya, Sefaniya,
Tahati, Asili, Ebiyasafu, Kola,
Isala, Kohati, Lefi ni Yakobo.
Asafu ŵaliji mlongo mjakwe jwa Hemani juŵaliji jwakulongolela likuga lyaŵili lya kwimba. Acinangolo ŵa Asafu ŵaliji Belekiya, Shimeya,
Mikaele, Baseya, Malikiya,
Etini, Sela, Adayiya,
Etani, Sima, Shimeyi,
Yahati, Geleshomu ni Lefi.

Etani jwa liŵasa lya Melali jwalongolelaga likuga lyatatu lya ŵandu ŵakwimba nyimbo. Liŵasa lyawo likutyocela kwa Lefi mwakuyicisyamu: Etani ŵaliji mwanace jwa Kishi, Kishi ŵaliji mwanace jwa Abidi, Abidi ŵaliji mwanace jwa Maluki, Maluki ŵaliji mwanace jwa Hashabiya, Hashabiya ŵaliji mwanace jwakuŵeleka Amasiya,
Amasiya ŵaliji mwanace jwakuŵeleka Hilikiya, Hilikiya ŵaliji mwanace jwakuŵeleka Amusi, Amusi ŵaliji mwanace jwakuŵeleka Bani ŵaliji mwanace jwakuŵeleka Shema,
Shema ŵaliji mwanace jwakuŵeleka Mali, Mali ŵaliji mwanace jwakuŵeleka Mushi, Mushi ŵaliji mwanace jwakuŵeleka Melali,
nipo Melali ŵaliji mwanace jwakuŵeleka Lefi.
Nipo Alefi ŵane wosope ŵasagulidwe kuti akamuleje masengo gane ga ku Nyumba jakupopelela.
Yisukulu ya Aloni
Aloni pamo ni ŵanace ŵakwe ŵacalume ŵapelekaga mbopesi pa malo ga kupelecela mbopesi syakutinisya sya ubani.
Jemanjajo ŵatendaga masengo gosope gakuŵajilwa pa malo geswela ni kutenda msyungu wakukululucila ulemwa
wa Aisalaeli. Ŵatendaga yeleyi pakukuya yosope yiŵalamwile Mose jwakutumicila jwa Mlungu.
Ŵanace ŵacalume ni yisukulu ya Aloni yaliji Eliyesa, Finihasi, Abishuwa, Buki, Usi, Selahiya, Melayoti, Amaliya, Ahitubi, Sadoki ni Ahimasi.
Malo gakutama Alefi
Aji jili dela jijapelecedwe kwa yisukulu ya Aloni ŵa liŵasa lya Kohati. Jemanjaji ŵaliji ŵandanda kupocela malo gakuti atamejemo.
Ŵapocele msinda wa Hebuloni mcilambo ca Yuda pampepe ni malo gakulicisya yilangwa gakusyungulila msindawo.
Migunda ni misi jijasyungulile msinda wa Hebuloni, japelecedwe kwa Kalebu mwanace jwa Yefune.

Misinda jakuyicisyaji japelecedwe kwa ŵanace ŵacalume ŵa Aloni pampepe ni malo gakulicisya yilangwa gagasyungulile misinda ja Hebuloni, msinda wakulupucilamo, Libina, Yatili, Eshitemowa, Hileni, Dibili, Ashani ni Beti Shemeshi.

Ŵandu ŵa lukosyo lwa Benjamini, ŵapegwile misinda ja Geba, Alemeti, ni Anatoti pampepe ni malo gakulicisya yilangwa yawo, gakusyungulila jele misindaji. Misinda jawo jiŵatamaga pamo ni maŵasa gawo jakwanile 13.
Misinda likumi ja mcilambo ca kungapilo lyuŵa kwa Manase ŵajipelece ku maŵasa ga lukosyo lwa Kohati pakulondola cisango.
Liŵasa lya Geleshomu lyapegwile misinda 13 pakukuya maŵasa gawo kutyocela ku ngosyo sya Isakala, Asha, Nafutali ni Manase jwakungopoko lyuŵa mcilambo ca Bashani.
Lukosyo lwa Melali lwapocele misinda likumi ni jiŵili pakukuya maŵasa gawo kutyocela ku ngosyo sya Lubeni, Gadi ni Sebuloni.
Amu ni mwele muŵapelecele ŵandu ŵa ku Isalaeli misinda kwa Alefi kuti atamejemo pampepe ni malo gakulicisya yilangwa gakusyungulila misindajo.
Misinda ja ngosyo sya Yuda, Simiyoni ni Benjamini ŵajipelece pakulondola cisango.
Maŵasa gane ga lukosyo lwa Kohati ŵagapele misinda ni malo gakulicisya yilangwa kutyocela ku lukosyo lwa Efelemu.
Maŵasa gelega ŵagapele misinda jakuyicisyaji ni malo gakulicisya yilangwa gagasyungulile misinda ja Shekemu ku cilambo ca ku matumbi ga Efelemu, Gesele,
Yokimimu, Beti Holoni,
Aiyaloni ni Gati Limoni.
Nambo kutyocela ku misinda ja kungapilo lyuŵa kwa Manase ŵapegwile misinda ja Aneli ni Bileyamu pamo ni malo gakulicisya yilangwa.
Maŵasa ga lukosyo lwa Geleshomu ŵagapele misinda jiŵili jakuyicisyaji, kutyocela ku lukosyo lwa Manase jwa kungopoko lyuŵa: Golani ku Bashani ni Ashitaloti pampepe ni malo gakulicisya yilangwa.
Kutyocela ku lukosyo lwa Isakala, ŵapegwile misinda ja Kedeshi, Dabelati,
Lamoti ni Anemu pampepe ni malo gakulicisya yilangwa gakusyungulila misindaji.
Kutyocela ku lukosyo lwa Asha, Agelesomu ŵapegwile misinda ja Mashali, Abidoni,
Hukoki ni Lehobu pampepe ni malo gakulicisya yilangwa gakusyungulila misindaji.
Kutyocela ku lukosyo lwa Nafutali, Agelesomu ŵapegwile misinda ja Kedeshi ku Galileya, Hamoni ni Kiliyataimu.
Maŵasa gakusigala ga lukosyo lwa Melali gapegwile misinda ja Limoni ni Taboli kutyocela ku lukosyo lwa Sebuloni, pampepe ni malo gakulicisya yilangwa gakusyungulila misindaji.
Ŵapocele soni misinda ja kungopoko lyuŵa kwa Lusulo lwa Yolodani kutyocela ku lukosyo lwa Lubeni, misinda ja Besala, mcilambo cangali matumbi, Yahasi,
Kedemoti ni Mefati, pampepe ni malo gakulicisya yilangwa gakusyungulila misindaji.
Kutyocela ku lukosyo lwa Gadi ŵandu ŵa liŵasa lya Melali ŵapocele misinda ja Lamoti ku Giliyadi, Mahanaimu,
Heshiboni ni Yasa pampepe ni malo gakulicisya yilangwa.
